=Abilities=

Raj can form energy blasts from his hands and also form barriers or some form of telekinesis with said energy. He also can use this energy to lift himself off the ground to appear as if he is flying and or floating.


=Story=

Raj Naidu was born into a group of criminals and has done deeds with the others his age for a while until one of the old men in the group, who was an undercover cop, tried to talk Raj out of continuing what he is doing and to change his ways. This undercover cop focused on Raj for Raj is a meta human, who knew of his abilities and kept it to himself.
During a major heist involving a VIP in India, Raj's friend and mentor told him that it is time to make change, for the other young ones follow Raj and what to be a strong leader like him, Raj had to make a choice during that heist and he made the positive choice.
Instead of rounding up the VIP and his associates for an execution, Raj went on a rampage on the plan, killing off the criminals who had brainwashed him. This caused Raj to nearly destroy the plane, so he used up his power to bring the plan down to safety, which took a toll on his body.

The leader of the rebel group was still alive, and managed to take the undercover cop and ran off with him outside the plane to Raj. Raj was on his knees and out of breathe for what he just did only to be confronted with another situation. The rebel leader told Raj to stop or else he will kill the "rat". Then the rebel leader turned the gun on Raj and told him that it is a shame that Raj turned on his father, he also revealed to Raj that he was the one who instructed Raj to kill his mother and father, to which Raj recalled an event in his life as a kid where the rebel leader had him round up 2 runaways, a man and a woman, who were stopped by the rebel leader. He then had Raj assassinate them using his abilities.
Raj brokedown and realized that he killed his parents, and he himself was about to be killed, only for the undercover cop to be shot. The cop revealed to Raj that he was his father who had survived Raj's energy blast a long time ago and pleaded to his son, saying he forgives him.
After realizing this, Raj fought and decimated the rebel leader in front of everyone. Raj was enraged and flew away never to be seen again.

Many years had passed and Raj became a young adult who recited in Turkey. Raj used his abilities to bring down criminals there and made a name for himself being called Blackhood.

=Trivia=
*Despite being a hero, Raj is sort of an anti-hero during some of his run ins with others who are normal/meta humans.
*Raj is mental unstable and very sensitive, if fueled with anger, his powers become stronger.
*The more anger Raj succumbs to, the more powerful his energy blasts/barriers become.
*Raj was nearly killed by The Establishment.
*Raj is an ally to Jason Konta.
